title: Audit
description: Problems found on the published site, to clear one by one — a list, not a score.

run.title: Last audit
run.truncated: Cut short — the list is incomplete

list.emptyOpen: No open issues in this view.
list.emptyIgnored: No ignored issues. An ignored issue comes back by itself when its time is up.
list.emptyResolved: Nothing resolved in the last 90 days.
list.nextAudit: Audits run daily; the next one picks up any new problem.

detail.empty: Select an issue to see its evidence and what to do.
detail.adminOnly: Only site administrators can ignore or audit again.

fix.title: Add a redirect for the old address
fix.explain: The link points to {{from}}, which no longer answers. A redirect sends readers and crawlers on to the address you choose; the next audit then resolves the issue.
fix.conflicts: This address is still a page: no redirect can take effect there.
fix.loops: This would make a redirect loop.
fix.done: Redirect added — it takes effect now.

rules.markdown~inconsistent: Markdown copy differs from the page
